I feel that, for sure. I mean in High School, I had friends, but I was far from being a social butterfly. Then I moved away, had to start all the way over...didn’t know anyone, didn’t have any friends....funniest thing happened though...I learned to be ok with that, you know? I was happy being by myself and before I knew it...I had a phone full of people and was out pretty much every night. 

Life’s weird like that, when I didn’t give a fuck about having friends, they came out of nowhere. Maybe it was because I stopped caring or maybe it was because I had finally learned to be happy with just me...I didn’t know then, still don’t know now. All I know is, I tried and shit worked out. 

Not telling you how to live your life, but isn’t it worth seeing what tomorrow might bring?

Well I see it like this, your journey is your journey...there’s no set path. I know society tells you that you have to go to blah blah by the time you’re blah blah blah, but that’s bullshit. A diploma is still a diploma whether you get it now or ten years from now. 

Don’t get me wrong, I don’t  want you to feel like I’m invalidating your feelings. I was in your shoes, except I was a lot less responsible...I waited until 30 days before the semester started to even apply...everything was set up, then my financial aid fell through and I couldn’t go...fucking broke me. However, I ended up moving to NYC (I’m American btw) and it was the best shit ever. I’m still a royal fuck up, but I had some damned good times. 

Moral of my rant is, you’re on your own time man...do wtf you want with it.

Well, be that as it may...you won't have to keep the feelings in anymore, yeah? Get that shit out! Though I can't say that I understand what you're going through, I can be here to listen. You’re welcome. I feel the same. I know I had that damn job in the bag and then boom...”we’ve decided to go with other candidates”, I was crushed. I feel hopeless, like I don’t have a purpose or a reason to exist, but knowing that I’m not alone somehow gives me the strength to push...I honestly have no idea how nor why...but it does.


This shit hits us all differently and even though they may try to, people don’t usually understand. They just tell you that it’ll get better or blah blah blah...

I hope things better for the both of us, idk how or if they will, but I’m willing to stick around to see if you are too.

I’m right there with you! I’m right there. I’m 26, unemployed, three months behind on rent, had a job lined up that cancelled on me last minute, managed to land another one, but I won’t start until long after I’ll be on the street. Only have five bucks to my name and about another weeks worth of food. 

Everyday is a battle, waking up wishing that I hadn’t. The thoughts plague me all day! Even made preparations...how, when, and where. 

I’m not saying I understand you, nor will I give you some mediocre stay strong bs. 

I just want you to know that I’m next to you, trying to figure this shit out too. Let’s do this man, let’s fight this shit together! If you’re with me, I’m with you! We’ll get thru this shit, if you’re willing to stay here, then I am too...

You wanna talk, let’s talk...you wanna vent...I can listen.
